name: evergarden
description: Publish what your agents write, and review it like a pull request.

scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler deploy && bun run db:migrate:remote
scripts.auth:schema: auth generate --config src/server/auth.ts --adapter drizzle --dialect sqlite --output src/server/db/auth-schema.ts --yes && oxfmt src/server/db/auth-schema.ts
scripts.check: oxfmt --check && oxlint --deny-warnings && auth check schema --config src/server/auth.ts && vitest run --passWithNoTests

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs sessions. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: The email you sign in with. That account becomes the **owner** of this instance; everyone else is a guest.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The secret of the same GitHub OAuth app.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional. Lets guests sign in with Google. Leave empty to offer GitHub only.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. The secret of the same Google OAuth client.

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: Optional. The public URL, such as `https://evergarden.example.com`. Leave empty to use the URL of each request.
